requirements:
# Temperature Logic Control

- **Difficulty:** Medium (medium)

## Requirements

Write a function block FB to implement a temperature control logic. The program should include the following functions:
1. Read the value of the temperature sensor through an analog input module.
2. Compare the read temperature value TemperatureSensorInput with the set temperature value SetTemperature.
3. If the actual temperature is lower than the set temperature, start the heater HeaterOutput.
4. If the actual temperature is higher than the set temperature, turn off the heater HeaterOutput.
5. If the heater works continuously for more than a certain period (for convenience, using 5s), it should trigger an overheating protection, automatically turn off the heater, and must wait for a certain period (for convenience, using 3s) before the overheating protection can be lifted.
6. Provide status indication, displaying the current temperature, set temperature, heater status, and whether overheating protection is triggered.
7. Provide temperature sensor fault judgment, if the read temperature value TemperatureSensorInput is less than 0 or greater than 100, it is considered a sensor fault, and the heater should be turned off.

## Interface Definition

| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `TemperatureSensorInput` | `REAL` | The input value of the temperature sensor, i.e., the actual temperature |
| Input | `SetTemperature` | `REAL` | The set temperature value |
| Output | `CurrentTemperature` | `REAL` | Display of the current temperature |
| Output | `SetTempDisplay` | `REAL` | Display of the set temperature |
| Output | `HeaterStatus` | `BOOL` | Display of the heater status |
| Output | `OverheatProtection` | `BOOL` | Display of the overheating protection status |
| Output | `HeaterOutput` | `BOOL` | The control output of the heater |

(*
  公共题库第 10 题：温度控制逻辑 (Temperature Logic Control)
  主功能块：Q10
  说明：离线 ST 单元，仅做编译/有限用例检查，不代表 CODESYS 编译或功能安全验证。

  需求映射：
  1) 通过 TemperatureSensorInput 读取温度
  2/3/4) 实际温度 < 设定温度 -> 开加热器；实际温度 > 设定温度 -> 关加热器
          （等于设定温度时保持原有输出，题面未定义，见总结）
  5) 加热器连续加热超过 5s -> 触发过热保护，强制关加热器；
     过热保护需等待 3s 才能解除
  6) 状态指示：CurrentTemperature / SetTempDisplay / HeaterStatus / OverheatProtection
  7) TemperatureSensorInput < 0.0 或 > 100.0 -> 传感器故障，强制关加热器

  计时实现说明：本离线后端不提供 RTRIG，且 TON 的复位行为不可靠，
  因此改用时间戳（读系统毫秒时间）自行计算连续加热时长与保护保持时长。
*)

FUNCTION_BLOCK Q10
VAR_INPUT
    TemperatureSensorInput : REAL;   (* 实际温度 *)
    SetTemperature         : REAL;   (* 设定温度 *)
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    CurrentTemperature : REAL;       (* 当前温度显示 *)
    SetTempDisplay     : REAL;       (* 设定温度显示 *)
    HeaterStatus       : BOOL;       (* 加热器状态显示 *)
    OverheatProtection : BOOL;       (* 过热保护状态显示 *)
    HeaterOutput       : BOOL;       (* 加热器控制输出 *)
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    T_OVERHEAT_LIMIT_MS : TIME := T#5S;  (* 连续加热上限 *)
    T_OVERHEAT_HOLD_MS  : TIME := T#3S;  (* 过热保护保持时间 *)
    TEMP_MIN_VALID      : REAL := 0.0;   (* 有效温度下限（含） *)
    TEMP_MAX_VALID      : REAL := 100.0; (* 有效温度上限（含） *)
END_VAR
VAR
    tNow         : TIME;         (* 本扫描时间戳 *)
    tHeatStart   : TIME;         (* 本次连续加热开始时刻 *)
    tOverStart   : TIME;         (* 本次过热保护开始时刻 *)
    tHeatDur     : TIME;         (* 已连续加热时长 *)
    tOverDur     : TIME;         (* 保护已保持时长 *)
    xHeatRunPrev : BOOL := FALSE; (* 上一扫描加热器状态 *)
    xOverPrev    : BOOL := FALSE; (* 上一扫描过热保护状态 *)
    xHeatRise    : BOOL;          (* 加热器上升沿 *)
    xOverRise    : BOOL;          (* 过热保护上升沿 *)
    xSensorFault : BOOL;          (* 传感器故障 *)
    xHeaterReq   : BOOL;          (* 温度调节请求 *)
    xHeaterOn    : BOOL;          (* 内部加热器命令 *)
    xOverheat    : BOOL;          (* 过热保护置位 *)
END_VAR

(* 本扫描时间戳 *)
tNow := TIME();

(* ---------- 1) 传感器故障判断 ---------- *)
xSensorFault := (TemperatureSensorInput < TEMP_MIN_VALID)
             OR (TemperatureSensorInput > TEMP_MAX_VALID);

(* ---------- 6) 状态显示 ---------- *)
CurrentTemperature := TemperatureSensorInput;
SetTempDisplay     := SetTemperature;

(* ---------- 2/3/4) 温度比较，产生加热请求 ---------- *)
IF TemperatureSensorInput < SetTemperature THEN
    xHeaterReq := TRUE;
ELSIF TemperatureSensorInput > SetTemperature THEN
    xHeaterReq := FALSE;
ELSE
    (* 相等：题面未定义，保持原有请求 *)
    xHeaterReq := xHeaterReq;
END_IF

(* ---------- 边沿检测（基于上一扫描保存的状态） ---------- *)
xHeatRise := xHeaterOn AND NOT xHeatRunPrev;
xOverRise := xOverheat AND NOT xOverPrev;

(* ---------- 5a) 连续加热计时 ---------- *)
IF xHeaterOn THEN
    IF xHeatRise THEN
        (* 加热器刚启动：从本时刻开始计连续工作时间 *)
        tHeatStart := tNow;
    END_IF
    tHeatDur := tNow - tHeatStart;
ELSE
    (* 加热器未工作：连续工作时间清零 *)
    tHeatStart := tNow;
    tHeatDur   := T#0S;
END_IF

(* 连续加热达到 5s：触发过热保护并立即关闭加热器 *)
IF xHeaterOn AND (tHeatDur >= T_OVERHEAT_LIMIT_MS) THEN
    xOverheat := TRUE;
END_IF

(* 加热器重新启动时清除旧的过热状态 *)
IF xHeatRise THEN
    xOverheat := FALSE;
END_IF

(* ---------- 5b) 过热保护保持计时 ---------- *)
IF xOverheat THEN
    IF xOverRise THEN
        tOverStart := tNow;
    END_IF
    tOverDur := tNow - tOverStart;
    (* 保持满 3s 后解除保护 *)
    IF tOverDur >= T_OVERHEAT_HOLD_MS THEN
        xOverheat := FALSE;
    END_IF
ELSE
    tOverStart := tNow;
    tOverDur   := T#0S;
END_IF

(* ---------- 输出合成 ---------- *)
IF xSensorFault THEN
    (* 7) 传感器故障时强制关加热器 *)
    xHeaterOn := FALSE;
ELSIF xOverheat THEN
    (* 5) 过热保护时强制关加热器 *)
    xHeaterOn := FALSE;
ELSE
    xHeaterOn := xHeaterReq;
END_IF

(* 保存本扫描状态，供下一扫描比较边沿 *)
xHeatRunPrev := xHeaterOn;
xOverPrev    := xOverheat;

OverheatProtection := xOverheat;
HeaterStatus       := xHeaterOn;
HeaterOutput       := xHeaterOn;
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
